question: What attainment in relation to the vidyā follows from reciting this practice?
premises: The practitioner should recite the prescribed practice.
Recitation results in becoming beloved of the vidyā.
This attainment occurs quickly and of itself.
inference: Therefore, one who recites this practice swiftly becomes the beloved of the vidyā.
uncertainties: vidyāyāḥ may refer specifically to mantra-knowledge, a deity, or a form of sacred knowledge.
plain_english: He should recite it; he will quickly become the beloved of the vidyā himself.
